notes.title: Game Notice: Little Knight 1 will be refurbished using UE5
notes.notes: [p]The New Product Festival is over, thank you all for putting it in and trying it out Due to the significant increase in the number of wish lists for the New Product Festival and high expectations for the game, the author has decided to abandon the PGM engine and use UE5 for the reset version of \[Little Knight][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/c415f913405277860104214072157f3104362d32.jpg"][/img]The new version will have more content and characters will have attribute abilities[/p][p]Can hold dual weapons, dual swords, sword shields, etc. \[Weapons still have their own special abilities][/p][p]Equipment will have two types of entries, up to a maximum of 5. Attribute entries/special effect entries are special: reset version players will be able to catch monsters and raise them. Monsters can help players fight, as well as take care of farms and clean up. Forge functions will have enhancement/leveling/mutation[/p][p]Skills will also be divided into several categories, such as light/dark/flame/shield, with each small skill having 3 special effects to choose from[/p][p]In addition to the above, there are many other features that will be added to the game. The author's proficiency in using UE5 will greatly reduce bugs[/p][p]In addition, the game's art has been comprehensively optimized, and the plot will tell how the protagonist becomes a holy thorn[/p][p]It will also be more convenient to switch between multiple languages \[in addition, due to insufficient funds during the production process, unfinished Little Knight 2 may be put on the shelves]. Please look forward to it to the fullest[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/65ebb495a4b05864ef7492fbb2088062e6bd1b6c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/db2f1fa629ac1e12a411f4aaf98b81a67401f4a2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/f464d1f06cb1e7af378c952f5a697bef9b7a8fbe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/ff88cf07b2f4cb90b9c3d6554a8f2ae36b010c88.jpg"][/img]化,[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171154/db2f1fa629ac1e12a411f4aaf98b81a67401f4a2.jpg"][/img][/p]
